field.label: Enable Tang
field.help: Start the Tang NBDE daemon (via socat) at boot.

field.label: Listen port
field.help: TCP port the Tang server listens on. Default: 9090.

field.label: Restrict to interfaces
field.help: The tangd daemon listens on all interfaces. Select the interfaces that should be allowed to reach it; the plugin then adds firewall rules that pass the Tang port on the selected interfaces and block it everywhere else. Leave empty to add no firewall rules (access is then governed by your existing ruleset).

field.label: Key directory
field.help: Directory where Tang stores its JWK key files. Default: /var/db/tang.

field.label: Log file
field.help: File that the daemon's stderr is appended to. Default: /var/log/tang.
